'''Di-go''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] employed by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with the team excavating [[The Imprisoned One's mind prison]], an operation which eventually ended in disaster.<ref name="SWTOR" />
